title: Hearing on the City's approach to construction safety
summary: The Council's Housing and Buildings Committee will examine how the Department of Buildings oversees construction site safety, including inspections, incident reporting, site safety training cards and staffing. The hearing follows recent incidents such as the partial collapse at the former Pfizer building on East 42nd Street, a fatal trench collapse in Bushwick and a fraudulent site safety training card scheme. Fatalities stayed at 8 in both fiscal years 2025 and 2026 even as overall injuries and incidents declined.
